senses.gloss:
ITA-9.4.29 niṣkrāmaṇasaṁskāraḥ निष्क्रामणसंस्कारः
Exposure of a baby to external environment
A ceremony performed in the fourth month in which the child is taken outdoors and exposed to the external environment for the first time.

ITA-1.9.3.2.14 niṣkriyaḥ निष्क्रियः
Inactive
Inactiveness of atma, indicating its principal quality of performing the duty of being a witness to events.

ITA-2.6.5 niṣṭhāpākaḥ निष्ठापाकः
Transformation at the level of absorption, assimilation

ITA-2.6.33 niṣṭhāpākaḥ निष्ठापाकः
Final phase of digestion
The final phase of action of transformative factors in the gastrointestinal tract on food, which results in the separation of nutrient part and waste product, and the manifestation of post-digestive transformation).

ITA-9.9.30 niṣphalaśukram निष्फलशुक्रम्
Inactive or dead sperm
Inactive or dead sperm which are insufficient for conception.
